1 | # Release
    2 | 
    3 | ## Local Linux build
    4 | 
    5 | ```bash
    6 | . "$HOME/.cargo/env"
    7 | export TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$(cat /home/irving/Documentos/llama-player-secrets/updater.key)"
    8 | export TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD=""
    9 | npm run tauri build
   10 | ```
   11 | 
   12 | Artifacts are written to `src-tauri/target/release/bundle/`.
   13 | 
   14 | ## Updater signing key
   15 | 
   16 | The updater public key is stored in `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`.
   17 | 
   18 | The private key is intentionally outside the repository:
   19 | 
   20 | ```text
   21 | /home/irving/Documentos/llama-player-secrets/updater.key
   22 | ```
   23 | 
   24 | For GitHub Actions, create these repository secrets:
   25 | 
   26 | ```text
   27 | TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
   28 | TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD
   29 | ```
   30 | 
   31 | `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` must contain the private key file content. The password can be empty if the key was generated without a password.
   32 | 
   33 | ## GitHub release
   34 | 
   35 | Push a version tag to build Linux, Windows and macOS bundles:
   36 | 
   37 | ```bash
   38 | git tag v0.1.0
   39 | git push origin v0.1.0
   40 | ```
   41 | 
   42 | The updater endpoint is configured for:
   43 | 
   44 | ```text
   45 | https://github.com/irving/llama-player/releases/latest/download/latest.json
   46 | ```
   47 | 
   48 | If the GitHub repository owner/name is different, update `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` before publishing.
   49 |
